rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for objects that can easily break, especially glass, ceramics, or other brittle materials.

example.english: This glass is very breakable, so be careful.
example.traditional: 呢隻玻璃杯好易碎㗎，小心啲。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 bo1 lei4 bui1 hou2 ji6 seoi3 gaa3 siu2 sam1 di1

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when an object is easily damaged or broken through ordinary handling rather than emphasizing brittleness.

example.english: This umbrella is breakable, so don't open it forcefully.
example.traditional: 呢把遮好易爛，唔好大力撐。
example.jyutping: ni1 baa2 ze1 hou2 ji6 laan6 m4 hou2 daai6 lik6 caang1
